overview: The committee reviewed legislative priorities and project timelines for the 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda. The discussion focused on structuring the multi-year zoning reform process and advancing ordinances related to housing stability, transit, and climate goals.

items.title: Zoning Reform Planning
items.summary: Chair Collins and President Bears outlined a plan to use a zoning consultant to break the comprehensive update into discrete categories such as housing production and corridor development.

items.title: Council Governing Agenda Status Tracking
items.summary: The committee discussed adding specific status labels and brief context sentences to the governing agenda to improve public transparency.

items.title: Condo Conversion Ordinance
items.summary: Chair Collins reported ongoing research into permitting procedures to manage the conversion of rental units into condominiums.

items.title: Housing Home Rule Petitions
items.summary: The committee reviewed pending petitions for a real estate transfer fee, tenant right of first refusal, and rent stabilization.

items.title: City Fee Schedule Review
items.summary: The committee discussed a multi-step process to update outdated city fees to reflect administrative costs and regional parity.

items.title: Cycling Safety Ordinance
items.summary: Discussion centered on legislating safety infrastructure requirements during road renovations and a proposal to explore bicycle registration fees.

items.title: Transportation Demand Management
items.summary: Councilors discussed creating a point-based system to incentivize developers to provide transit alternatives and alleviate traffic congestion.

items.title: Energy Disclosure and Benchmarking
items.summary: The committee reviewed plans to require energy efficiency reporting for buildings, pending coordination with developing state legislation.

items.title: Rental Licensing Ordinance
items.summary: Councilors discussed prioritizing a mandatory landlord registration program to assist with building code enforcement and housing stability notifications.

items.title: Pesticide, Blasting, and Green Score Regulations
items.summary: The committee reviewed various environmental regulations, noting that a blasting ordinance is currently under review by the fire department.

items.title: Ongoing Oversight Items
items.summary: The committee briefly reviewed the sign permitting subcommittee schedule and ongoing projects for building retrofits and transit signal priority.

items.title: Traffic Commission Structure
items.summary: President Bears proposed restructuring the Traffic Commission via ordinance to improve public input and replace the current 1958 special act framework.

items.title: Agenda Reorganization
items.summary: Approved moving Transportation Demand Management and the Green Score project under the Zoning Reform umbrella.
